name: RiseWell Scrubby Floss

Under "No Teflon," the brand states: "RiseWell Floss: 100% free of Teflon and PFAS."
The brand page lists the size as 30 meters. Amazon ASIN B09TZJCC14 is titled as 30 yards. Check the package.

RiseWell's testing page shows third-party results for several products. This directory did not find a table on that page headed Scrubby Floss, so it does not copy a "not detected" line onto this floss.
